children: BNB Standard named Alex Odagiu as its new chief executive.
Odagiu, who has served as the company's interim president since June, will continue to serve as a member of the board, BNB Standard said Monday.

Odagiu helped lead the company's rebrand to BNB Standard from CEA Industries, as well as the launch of its website and treasury dashboard earlier this month. Previously, he worked as an investment partner at YZiLabs.
His appointment comes after BNB Standard said in March that David Namdar would step down from the top role by the end of August.

The digital-asset treasury company also said Monday it will operate its own validator on BNB Chain. The company plans to select a specialist infrastructure provider to run the validator's technical operations under its governance.
